projects.responsibility: CPU and host inventory, bounded benchmarks, profiling evidence, static analysis, embedded reference data and classical simulation
projects.policy: Local read-only hardware inspection; no clock, voltage, firmware or device writes.

projects.responsibility: Reaper language, reference runtime, compiler/tooling, Studio, LSP/DAP, parsers, build and test adapters
projects.policy: Explicit permissions and resource quotas; never execute as kernel code.

projects.responsibility: Device and driver inventory, package and binary inspection, signature evidence, hashes, SBOM and supply-chain metadata
projects.policy: Never install, load, flash, patch or execute inspected driver/package content.

projects.responsibility: Offline DSP, sample generation, WAV/MIDI processing, synthesis, effects, music metadata and audio analysis
projects.policy: Deterministic offline processing by default; real-time audio and device access require a separately reviewed OS service.

projects.responsibility: Future operating-system integration host and system-service boundary
projects.policy: OS components are not implemented until source, build, boot and hardware tests exist.

shared_rules: Adopt concepts and independently implemented interfaces, not copied proprietary code.
Review every dependency license before adding it; do not assume GPL compatibility with MIT or Apache-2.0.
Keep hardware inspection read-only unless a separately reviewed, explicit privileged operation is designed.
Use deterministic local operation as the default; remote services are optional and disclosed.
Record provenance, schema version, source quality and unknown values in machine-readable reports.
Mark a capability implemented only when source code, tests and documented limits are present.
